payload.default: Last-write-wins with optimistic locking: use job row version/updated_at for compare-and-swap. Second command sees conflict, re-reads current state, re-validates preconditions, then either succeeds (if still valid) or fails fast with clear error. Each command is a single atomic transaction; no partial states observable.
payload.text: What consistency guarantee is required when two operators invoke conflicting commands on the same job simultaneously (e.g., stop + wind-back, or two wind-backs to different seqs)?
